openFindings.title: Relocation feature page and changelog still state the pre-008 exit contract and omit status 3
openFindings.description: The feature page and changelog document a 0/1/2 exit contract that omits phase-008 status 3, so a landed move whose only failure is the moved packet validation is described as a failed close.
openFindings.scopeProof: The same omission appears in feature-catalog/feature-catalog.md:690 and changelog/v2.13.0.0.md:67; runtime/cli/spec/README.md:120 is current. rg over the three stale surfaces returns all three, so a single current reference exists and the three summaries are the class of gap.

openFindings.title: Published next-number command ignores archived packets
openFindings.description: The SKILL quick reference computes the next number from live root packets only, and the phase-definition guide describes the same live-only rule, contrary to D4 and create.sh.
openFindings.scopeProof: rg for "Next spec number" and "next number after the highest numbered packet" returns SKILL.md:295 and phase-definitions.md:82; create.sh:1644 is the only producer that implements both live and archived counting.

openFindings.title: Renumbered restore docs say every relocation failure exits 1, but status 3 is a successful restore
openFindings.description: The lifecycle feature page documents a failed relocation during restore as exit 1, while archive.sh treats relocation status 3 as a successful restore and exits 0 with a warning.
openFindings.scopeProof: rg for the restore failure sentence and status-3 branch returns the lifecycle page and archive.sh; the command README omits the branch rather than contradicting it, so the lifecycle page is the only changed doc asserting the blanket exit-1 rule.

openFindings.title: The archive command reference and lifecycle docs omit the mixed-track restore refusal
openFindings.description: The archive command reference and lifecycle docs do not document the mixed-track restore refusal, although archive.sh asks the relocation preflight and exits 1 when the restore would leave flat packets beside sub-tracks.
openFindings.scopeProof: rg for mixed-track and "would hold flat packets" over the changed docs returns only relocation-preflight language and tests; none of the archive-facing docs names the restore refusal.

openFindings.title: Archive-search docs omit archivedPaths and misstate the path record shape
openFindings.description: Archive-search documentation omits archivedPaths and says the path record is unchanged, while rg-wrapper.mjs always adds archivedPaths and the phase 009 completion criterion reads it.
openFindings.scopeProof: rg for archivedPaths over the changed docs returns zero hits; the implementation and tests are the only occurrences. The same omission appears in retrieval-conventions.md:84, search.md:116, README.txt:105, search-presentation.txt:120, README.md:1205, system-spec-kit/README.md:332, and feature-catalog.md:1078.

openFindings.title: suggest-subtracks docs say three no-map cases, but a non-NNN-slug packet adds a fourth
openFindings.description: The structure reference and sub-track feature page say suggest-subtracks has exactly three no-map cases, while the implementation and phase 009 criterion add a fourth for non-NNN-slug packet folder names.
openFindings.scopeProof: rg for "prints no map in three cases" over the changed docs finds the structure reference and the feature page; both omit the naming case. The implementation branch returns before the threshold and grouping checks.

openFindings.title: Root and skill READMEs summarize relocation without the status-3 contract
openFindings.description: The two top-level README summaries omit status 3, so a first-read operator has no cue that a landed run can exit 3 with a packet-validation warning.
openFindings.scopeProof: rg for "relocate.mjs.*Dry run by default" finds the two summaries and the feature page; runtime/cli/spec/README.md:120 is current.

openFindings.title: archive.sh --help omits both new restore outcomes
openFindings.description: The built-in help lists only the happy-path restore and next-number notes; it omits the mixed-track refusal and the status-3 success warning.
openFindings.scopeProof: The help heredoc at archive.sh:52-95 is the only command-level help block; no other archive help text exists.

openFindings.title: Relocation docs describe only whole-id rewrites and omit the phase-007 bare-name and pre-archive passes
openFindings.description: The relocation feature page describes only whole-id rewriting, omitting the phase-007 bare-name pass and pre-archive alias, and its test table names only relocate.vitest.ts.
openFindings.scopeProof: rg for "bare name|pre-archive|preArchive|whole old id" over the changed docs finds the feature page whole-id sentence and no bare-name/pre-archive description; the command README also says only "rewrites every whole old id".

openFindings.title: The v2.13.0.0 changelog stopped at the phase-005 release and its test counts no longer match the packet
openFindings.description: The v2.13.0.0 changelog reports 2567 tests and pre-008 behavior, while the packet log records 2603 tests after phase 010 and the changed code ships status 3, resume, mixed-track restore, archivedPaths, and non-NNN refusal.
openFindings.scopeProof: rg for 2567 tests, 2603, status 3 and archivedPaths over the changelog and goal log returns the old count and no later behavior; ls changelog shows no v2.13.1 or later entry.

openFindings.title: Manual scenario 492 still exercises only the pre-remediation relocation surface
openFindings.description: Scenario 492 covers a dry run, a refused archived number, and an applied renumber only; it never exercises status 3, late-step resume, case-folded duplicates, phase-map bare names, pre-archive ids, or mixed-track restore.
openFindings.scopeProof: The 492 file is the only relocation scenario registered in the manual playbook at manual-testing-playbook.md:245; no second scenario covers the phase 006-010 paths.

openFindings.title: Feature and playbook source inventories still list only relocate.vitest.ts
openFindings.description: The catalog test table names only relocate.vitest.ts, omitting the phase-010 true-writer suite and the archive-numbering/archive-track/rg-include-archive suites.
openFindings.scopeProof: rg for relocate-real-pipeline over the changed documentation returns no hit; the only mention is the test file and the packet log.

Packet log is current; changelog/catalog/playbook still lag.
